en.title: Admission-aware render preparation and opt-in recovery
en.body: BrowserFrameLoop, BrowserGame and Play accept an optional beforeRender callback after the pending-frame check, plus an explicit bounded renderRetry decision. Logic and time are not replayed; default failures and validation remain strict.

zh.title: 准入后绘制准备及可选的有限错误恢复
zh.body: BrowserFrameLoop、BrowserGame 和 Play 支持在待完成帧检查之后的可选 beforeRender 回调，以及显式有限次数的 renderRetry 决策。逻辑和时间不重放，默认错误行为及校验保持严格。
